title: How oscillation parameters become a line
summary: Follow frequency, phase and damping from a formula to a continuous path on the canvas.

sections.heading: Observe first
paragraphs: On the original site, change the frequency ratio, phase or damping and watch how the drawing changes.

sections.heading: What the code shows
paragraphs: A parameter object stores values including frequency ratio, phase and damping. machine derives oscillation parameters, and pos calculates the pen position at a given time.

sections.heading: Where to start reading
paragraphs: Start with the parameters and machine and pos functions. Then follow drawTo as it samples successive positions and joins them into a Canvas 2D path.

sections.heading: Try a small exercise
paragraphs: On the original site, compare 1:1 and 2:3 while keeping the other settings as similar as possible. Then change damping and observe how quickly the line contracts.

sections.heading: Scope and limits
paragraphs: This note is based on reading a fixed source revision; we did not run the repository code. The repository license was not confirmed, and the creator’s original prompt is linked separately.
